title: AAC: Admissible-by-Architecture Differentiable Landmark Compression for ALT
abstract: arXiv:2604.20744v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce the Architecturally Admissible Compressor (AAC), which adapts landmark-based A* heuristics to query demand under a fixed label-memory budget. AAC provides two continuous relaxations of ALT (A*, Landmarks, and Triangle inequality) selection. With exact landmark distances, every parameter value defines a lower bound on shortest-path distance. Both relaxations deploy ALT using only the selected labels. The row-stochastic relaxation takes convex combinations of landmark distances. We characterize the maximal admissibility-preserving linear classes and prove that the relaxed and discrete optima coincide. The fractional relaxation mixes subset heuristics and supports continuous greedy (AAC-CG) with exact gradients and an entropy-regularized oracle for differentiable selection. translated_title: AAC：面向ALT的架构级可采纳可微分地标压缩
translated_abstract: 我们提出了架构可采纳压缩器（AAC），它在固定的标签内存预算下，使基于地标的A*启发式方法能够适应查询需求。AAC为ALT（A*、地标与三角不等式）选择提供了两种连续松弛形式。在地标距离精确的前提下，每一个参数取值都定义了最短路径距离的一个下界。两种松弛形式都仅使用被选中的标签来部署ALT。行随机松弛形式采用地标距离的凸组合。我们刻画了保持可采纳性的最大线性类，并证明了松弛最优解与离散最优解相一致。分数松弛形式混合了子集启发式，并支持带有精确梯度的连续贪心算法（AAC-CG），以及用于可微分选择的熵正则化预言机。对于期望启发式值，我们证明了包含有限步数项、预言机误差项和有限样本项的近似保证。极限情形下的 $1-1/e$ 因子（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出AAC，在固定标签内存预算下通过两种可采纳性保持的连续松弛实现可微分的ALT地标选择压缩，并给出了带有1-1/e极限因子的近似保证。
en_tdlr: AAC enables differentiable ALT landmark compression under a fixed label-memory budget via two admissibility-preserving continuous relaxations, with proven approximation guarantees including a limiting 1-1/e factor.
